assertions.description: quinn-rocks skill-run signal file was written
quinn-rocks skill-run did not end in failure
quinn-rocks working memory file written to memory/working/
quinn-rocks working memory file is substantive (>200 bytes)
quinn-rocks working memory contains expected content

Quinn Q3 (goal-grounding): the rock-review output references the actual quarterly objectives — a quarter label (Q# YYYY), the objectives file, or named rocks with a status. Rock deltas recorded is Q3's second half; the status vocabulary (on/at risk/off track) is the delta signal. Pass = 100%.
Quinn Q4 (Tier 3 grade >= B): rock-review quality is judged by Tier 3 grading. Honest alternative — grade presence at B or better; defers (skipped) until graded.
